facts: [cpu] reason C_THROTTLED (block): CPU is throttled in 60% of periods: the container is hitting its CPU limit, so observed usage understates demand.
[memory] reason I_KRR_AT_FLOOR (info): KRR's memory figure equals KRR's own minimum, so it is not based on usage; using this tool's own figure instead.
[memory] reason I_FLOOR (info): Candidate 4Mi is below the minimum 32Mi; using the minimum.
limitation: Workload name is inferred from the pod name.
limitation: Revisions are not tracked, so samples from different releases are mixed.
limitation: Usage figures are the highest value across pods (conservative).
limitation: p50/p95/max use a 5-minute CPU rate; peak_1m uses a 1-minute rate and is still limited by the scrape interval.
limitation: No latency, error-rate or SLO data is included.
limitation: History covers about 4.7 h of the requested 6.0 h window.

parsed.headline: CPU Request Decrease Blocked, Memory Request Decrease OK

cpu.explanation: The CPU request is blocked from decreasing because the container is throttled in 60% of periods. This indicates that the container is hitting its CPU limit, so observed usage understates demand.

memory.explanation: The memory request can decrease to 32Mi from the current 64Mi. The candidate request was initially 4Mi, but it was adjusted to meet the minimum floor of 32Mi.

caveats: Workload name is inferred from the pod name.
Revisions are not tracked, so samples from different releases are mixed.
Usage figures are the highest value across pods (conservative).
p50/p95/max use a 5-minute CPU rate; peak_1m uses a 1-minute rate and is still limited by the scrape interval.
No latency, error-rate or SLO data is included.
History covers about 4.7 h of the requested 6.0 h window.
